Name: Nude Farmer and Swimsuits - Unofficial 1.6 Update
Author: sumaniBlack
Description:
[size=4]This is an unofficial update for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5029]Nude Farmer and Swimsuits[/url] mod from simezi21(thanks again for giving the okay - seriously: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26311]I have permission[/url]) - if you like this go over there and endorse it.

[b]This mod will be available until simezi21 either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/b][/size]

[size=4]Change the player sprite to a naked female and change the existing shirt and pants to match the naked sprite.
Add swimsuits and other outfits and hats for naked sprites.
The added costumes can be purchased in Sandy's store.
The added costume is an integrated upper and lower garment, so please remove the shirt from the equipment when using it.
Futanari change and boots display can be configured from the Generic Mod Config Menu.
The clothes and head dresses will be added to Lilith's shop in this mod now to reduce interconnectivity of the mods.

[b]Troubleshooting:[/b]
I restructured the mod for better understanding, but that means there was an awful lot of copying and deleting stuff involved. If you have a problem with the animations I need to know which base farmer you use (male female) and if they are bald (no shadow under the hair). Also if there are errors in the SMAPI log.

When switching to futanari I had to restart the game for the texture overlays to load correctly.
When reactivating changes for male or female I had to restart the game for the texture overlays to load correctly.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[size=4]1.Download and extract this mod and the Required Mod.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.[/size]
